system.description: Stony peaks that pierce the clouds, with a twisting path winding its way up and over through many switchbacks.
system.notes:
Standard | Traversal

Stony peaks that pierce the clouds, with a twisting path winding its way up and over through many switchbacks.
Impulses: Exact a chilling toll in supplies and stamina, reveal magical tampering, slow down travel

Difficulty: 15

Features

Wind Patterns - Passive: The shape of the cliffs and snowdrifts reveals dangerous wind tunnels in the pass. A PC with a relevant background or Experience can read the signs of shifting weather. A PC who succeeds on a Wits Roll can predict when the worst gusts will hit and find safer paths through the area. On a critical success, they gain Advantage on furtherr rolls to cross safely.

Avalanche - Action: Spend a Fear to carve the mountain with an icy torrent, causing an avalanche. All PCs in its path must succeed on a Finesse or Brawn Reaction Roll or be bowled over and carried down the mountain. A PC using rope, pitons, or other climbing gear gains advantage on this roll. Targets who fail are knocked down the mountain to Far range, take 2d6 physical damage, and must mark a Stress. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

Eagle Nest - Reaction: When the PCs enter the eagles' hunting grounds, two Giant Eagles appear at Very Far range of a chosen PC, identifying the PCs as likely prey.

Icy Winds - Reaction: Countdown (Loop 4). When the PCs enter the mountain pass, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all characters traveling through the pass must succeed on a Brawn Reaction Roll or mark a Stress. A PC wearing clothes appropriate for extreme cold gains Advantage on these rolls.
